% ===== Tema visual — Charcutaria Mantovani (bordô + creme) =====
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{bordo}{HTML}{8B1A1A}
\definecolor{bordoescuro}{HTML}{5A1212}
\definecolor{creme}{HTML}{F4ECDC}
\definecolor{cremesuave}{HTML}{FBF6EC}
\definecolor{cinzatexto}{HTML}{2B2320}

\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\section}{\LARGE\bfseries\color{bordo}}{\thesection}{0.6em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\large\bfseries\color{bordoescuro}}{\thesubsection}{0.5em}{}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}{\normalsize\bfseries\color{bordo}}{}{0em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{2.2ex plus 1ex minus .2ex}{1.2ex plus .2ex}

% Cabeçalho / rodapé
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\setlength{\headheight}{15pt}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.6pt}
\renewcommand{\headrule}{\hbox to\headwidth{\color{bordo}\leaders\hrule height \headrulewidth\hfill}}
\fancyhead[L]{\small\color{bordo}\textbf{MantovaniHub}}
\fancyhead[R]{\small\color{bordoescuro}Charcutaria Mantovani}
\fancyfoot[C]{\small\color{bordoescuro}\thepage}

% Tabelas mais arejadas
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{array}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.28}
\usepackage{ragged2e}

% Caixas de destaque
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}

% Espaçamento
\usepackage{setspace}
\setstretch{1.07}

% Paisagem (diagrama) e quebras
\usepackage{pdflscape}
\usepackage{needspace}

% Glifos ausentes na Georgia → renderizados via modo matemático (independe da fonte)
\usepackage{newunicodechar}
\newunicodechar{→}{\ensuremath{\rightarrow}}
\newunicodechar{≈}{\ensuremath{\approx}}
\newunicodechar{≥}{\ensuremath{\geq}}
\newunicodechar{≤}{\ensuremath{\leq}}
\newunicodechar{×}{\ensuremath{\times}}

% Quebra de linhas longas em blocos de código (script SQL), preservando o realce.
% Adiada para \AtBeginDocument para sobrescrever a definição do próprio pandoc.
\usepackage{fvextra}
\fvset{breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true}
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \definecolor{shadecolor}{HTML}{FBF6EC}%
  \DefineVerbatimEnvironment{Highlighting}{Verbatim}{breaklines,breakanywhere,commandchars=\\\{\},fontsize=\footnotesize}%
}
